append.detail: The Spotlight background in components/spotlight/spotlight-shell.tsx was a raw img of the creator's original upload (up to 5 MB, SPOTLIGHT_MAX_BYTES) in a fixed viewport-filling wrapper, so every visitor downloaded the full-resolution file with no resize, no AVIF/WebP and no LCP hint, while the header and avatar in the same file already used next/image. The img (and its eslint-disable) is now a next/image fill with sizes 100vw inside the existing fixed inset-0 wrapper, keeping the focal point and zoom styles and the dim overlay; it preloads only when no header image sits above it (this fork uses preload, not priority), and deliberately does not set loading=eager because on this fork eager also emits a preload link and would compete with the header's. Pinned by components/spotlight/spotlight-shell.test.tsx: the background renders as an optimizer srcset (/_next/image) sized 100vw and never the raw storage URL, preloads exactly when it is the LCP candidate (one preload link with a header, the header's), keeps object-position and scale, and renders no layer when no background is set.
